pr_title: repart: BSD lock block device before rereading partition table
pr_body:
Let's take an exclusive lock on the block device before telling
fdisk to reread the partition table so avoid transient errors when
something else (like udev) is operating on the block device.

Fixes https://github.com/systemd/systemd/issues/27236
pr_comments: this doesn't look right to me, we already have an exclusive lock on the device, via context_load_partition_table(). If you take another one here this will deadlock
(and whenever we open a new loopback block device we create it with LOOP_EX, too)
Ah oops I forgot we already take a lock, curious where the error in the issue is coming from then, I guess there's something else that isn't taking a lock?
i wonder if for some reason we are not going through the codepath that actually locks things in that test case. dunno.
